articles.summary: At Accend, we've secured SOC 2 Type II compliance, underscoring our dedication to safeguarding customer data and reinforcing trust. Partnering with Vanta and Advantage Partners, we efficiently navigated the audit journey, emphasizing forward-thinking security strategies. Our journey highlighted the value of early security implementations, capitalizing on trust to grow business, and choosing the ideal partners for compliance.
articles.title: Accend is Now SOC 2 Type II Compliant
